biography.plain_text: Judith Sheindlin, known as Judge Judy, is an American television producer and former New York family-court judge. Her courtroom programme turned her legal experience into a broadcasting business. She negotiated ownership of its episode library before selling those rights to CBS, and developed further court shows through her company, Queen Bee Productions.

long_biography.plain_text:
American television personality Judith Sheindlin helped create Her Honor Mentoring with her stepdaughter, lawyer Nicole Sheindlin. Nicole wanted to connect young women with successful professionals; Judith added a requirement that their work should be paid. She funded that part of the programme, linking workplace experience to lessons in saving, spending and managing earnings.

The initiative paired high-school students with leaders in their professions for weekly workplace apprenticeships and monthly workshops. The wider model supplements workplace contact with guided discussions about education and careers, plus electives such as field trips, digital courses and creative projects.
